short_description: Enterprise-grade HIPAA-compliant video conferencing for healthcare with virtual waiting rooms, screen sharing, and EHR integrations.
long_description: Zoom for Healthcare is the HIPAA-compliant version of the popular Zoom video conferencing platform, specifically designed for healthcare providers. Built on Zoom's reliable infrastructure that supports billions of meeting minutes daily, the healthcare version includes a signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA), enhanced security controls, and compliance features required for protected health information. The platform offers HD video and audio, virtual waiting rooms, screen sharing, session recording with cloud storage, and breakout rooms for group therapy sessions. Zoom for Healthcare integrates with major EHR systems including Epic, Cerner, and athenahealth through APIs and embeddable SDKs. Mental health professionals benefit from the platform's widespread patient familiarity, reducing the learning curve for telehealth sessions. Features like virtual backgrounds, noise suppression, and mobile apps for iOS and Android ensure professional, high-quality sessions from any location.

pricing.notes: HIPAA-compliant features and BAA require Pro plan or higher. Healthcare add-on ensures compliance features are enabled. Volume discounts available for larger organizations.

seo.title: Zoom for Healthcare: HIPAA-Compliant Video Conferencing
seo.meta_description: Zoom for Healthcare offers HIPAA-compliant video conferencing with BAA, virtual waiting rooms, and EHR integrations. Starting at $15.99/month per host.

faqs.q: Is Zoom HIPAA compliant for therapy sessions?
faqs.a: Yes, Zoom for Healthcare is HIPAA compliant when you have a Pro plan or higher with the Healthcare add-on. Zoom provides a signed BAA (Business Associate Agreement) at no additional cost. Ensure you enable security features like waiting rooms, meeting passwords, and disable cloud recording if storing PHI.

faqs.q: Can patients join Zoom sessions without downloading the app?
faqs.a: Yes, patients can join via web browser, though the experience is optimized with the Zoom app. The browser option (Zoom Web Client) works on Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari. Some features like virtual backgrounds may be limited in browser mode.

faqs.q: Does Zoom support group therapy sessions?
faqs.a: Yes, Zoom excels at group sessions with support for up to 100 participants on Pro plans (up to 1000 on Enterprise). Features like breakout rooms, gallery view, spotlight, and co-host capabilities make it ideal for group therapy, family sessions, and support groups.

faqs.q: How does Zoom video quality compare to other telehealth platforms?
faqs.a: Zoom offers excellent HD video quality (720p standard, 1080p available) with adaptive bitrate that adjusts to bandwidth. The platform is known for reliability with 99.9% uptime. AI-powered noise suppression and virtual backgrounds enhance professionalism.
